To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the collection of aerosolized proteins by six different aerosol samplers generates aggregation patterns and activity levels that are different for the same protein.

(1) protein stability is affected by the aerosol sampler used for collection; (2) this impact depends on the protein and the aerosol sampler; (3) protein aggregation is affected by the collection method, but not biological activity.
aerosol samplers can impact protein stability in aerosols, that the impact depends on the protein and that the same aerosol collection device should be used throughout the development process.

the development of new inhaled protein formulations and the study of protein stability during nebulisation.
the development and validation of a new method of aerosol collection, the electrostatic precipitator, and its use in aerosol characterization studies.
the impact of collection on protein stability.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
aerosol sampling is an important step that should not be underestimated and that should be carefully selected and optimized for a given aerosol formulation.
the collection step should not be overlooked and that a thorough characterization of the collection step is needed to ensure the stability of the aerosolized proteins.
protein stability during nebulisation is highly dependent on the collection device and should therefore be evaluated for each protein and collection device combination.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
protein stability during nebulized aerosolization is not a simple matter, and that the collection step must be taken into account in the development process.
the collection step of the aerosol development is as important as the nebulization process.
aerosol collection devices should be considered when assessing aerosolized protein stability.

aerosol samplers must not be overlooked when developing inhaled protein therapeutics.
the collection step is as important as nebulization to ensure that the aerosolized product is stable and active.
